transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I came in because since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve been more on edge and kind of down. I’ve been snapping over little things at home, then I get to class or the shop already drained. I’m still getting by, but I missed a couple deadlines and backed out of helping with the theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
Did these changes start after your sister and her baby moved back home?
Yeah. I was doing okay before they moved in. Within a couple weeks of the house getting crowded, that’s when things started getting harder.
If your home situation were to settle down, do you think your low mood and feeling on edge would mostly go away?
I think so, yeah. It’s hard to tell while they’re still living with us, because nothing’s really changed yet. It all feels tied to the house being crowded and the new routine.
Have you been losing interest or enjoyment in things you usually like to do?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change with that, honestly.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
Yeah, most days lately I’ve felt kind of down and worn out. It started after my sister and the baby moved in—everything at home just feels like a lot.
Have you been feeling down like this nearly every day for at least 2 weeks?
Yeah. It’s been about a month now, since my sister and her baby moved back in.
Have you had trouble sleeping lately?
I’m not really sure—I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep lately.
Have you been feeling nervous or anxious a lot lately?
Yeah, I think so. Since they moved in, I’ve been more on edge than usual—snapping over little things around the house.
Have these feelings been causing problems with how you function in daily life?

I’m still going to class and work, but yeah, it’s made things harder. I’ve turned in a couple assignments late, and I had to drop the community theater set project because I couldn’t keep up with everything.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite lately?
I haven’t really noticed any change in my appetite, honestly.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty lately?
No, I haven’t really been feeling worthless or especially guilty.
Have you been having trouble concentrating lately?
Yeah, some. I’m still going to class and work, but I’ve turned in a couple assignments late, and I had to drop the community theater set project because I couldn’t keep up with everything.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die or of hurting yourself?
No. I haven’t had thoughts about wanting to die or hurting myself.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
Yeah, more than usual. I’ve been showing up to class or the shop already feeling kind of drained.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual, or feeling so restless that it’s hard to sit still?
I haven’t really noticed either of those.
During the past month, have you been sleeping less or more than usual?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear change in how much I’m sleeping.
Do your feelings seem stronger than you would expect for your sister and her baby moving back home?
Yeah, I think so. Since they moved in, I’ve been more on edge and down, and I’ve been snapping over little things at home. It feels like it’s throwing me off more than it probably should.
Do you feel on edge in situations outside of home too?
Mostly it starts at home, but it kind of carries over. I’ll get to class or the shop already feeling drained and on edge, and then it’s harder to keep up with things.
Before your sister and her baby moved back home, were you already feeling down or on edge?
No, I was doing okay before they moved in. It started within a couple weeks after the house got crowded.
Have you been able to control the worrying, or does it feel hard to stop?
I’m not really sure what you mean by worrying. I just know I’ve been feeling more tense since they moved in.
